Typography: a journal serif, a newsroom grotesk, a lab mono
nodes.rationale: Serif leads, grotesk works. Newsreader optical sizes keep it crisp at 14 px and elegant at 64 px; Schibsted Grotesk was drawn for a newspaper so it stays plain under pressure; Urdu script UI waits for validated Urdu instruments, so Urdu appears in brand moments only until then.

nodes.rationale: The queue sorts by urgency; every flag opens onto the exact answers, wording and timestamps that raised it. Nav: Queue, Patients, Alerts, Exports, Assistant, Settings (user Dr. A. Khan).
